style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for retail hero and variant; soft light-blue gradient studio #BFD4EF to #C9DAF2 for feature demos; deepest dusty blue #8B95B2 to #98A2BE reserved for the install CTA frame
style.direction: clean tech-minimal phone-accessory e-commerce: black-gold retail anchor plus light-blue studio feature demos, one benefit per frame
style.iconSystem: thin-line rounded-square icons in single blue #3D6CB8 on light grounds, at most six per frame
style.lightingSystem: bright soft diffuse studio light, edge-lit glass with diagonal light streaks, faint contact shadows only, no hard shadows
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: clean tech-minimal e-commerce suite for a tempered glass screen protector. Black-and-gold retail hero with stacked glass sheets and a translucent alignment frame on pure white #FFFFFF; feature demos sit on soft light-blue studio backdrops #BFD4EF to #C9DAF2 where floating glass is edge-lit with white outlines and diagonal light streaks; a macro corner-fit frame shows white glow arcs; a durability test fires golden sparks #F0C868; the easy-install CTA runs on the deepest dusty blue #8B95B2 with a purple alignment frame #B65AD4 and a single fingertip. Bright soft diffuse studio light, faint contact shadows, no hard shadows. Bold short sans-serif headlines in slate blue #3D6CB8 or white #FFFFFF, thin-line blue icons, one benefit per frame. The privacy variant reuses the exact hero composition with smoky-gray glass #55565A and a cyan frame #3AC4D6. Strip all brand marks; never show compatibility charts, red warning banners, third-party device logos or fabricated certificates.
noDrift: no warm wood or homey grounds
no third-party phone brand marks or greeting wallpapers
style.presentationRules: product occupies 55-75% in feature frames and 25-30% in packshots, one claim per frame, glass always edge-lit and tack sharp, human hand appears only in the install frame, variant frames reuse the exact hero composition
style.surfaceSystem: high-transparency tempered glass with white edge outline, matte black retail card, translucent alignment frame plastic
style.temperature: cool neutral studio light, warm gold only on retail packaging and test sparks
style.typography: bold short sans-serif headlines in slate blue #3D6CB8 on light grounds and white #FFFFFF on dark grounds, one title plus one subline maximum
